SUCR01.criterion: Verify exact Study V1 artifacts, Decision-0111 checkpoint, source bindings, checksum closure, and safe-verifier reproducibility without modifying the author-candidate study.
SUCR01.title: Exact Study V1 integrity and source binding

SUCR02.criterion: Verify exactly 109 semantic units, 171 Schema-V2 property paths, and 18,639 unique unit/carrier pairs with complete Cartesian coverage and no missing or duplicate pairs.
SUCR02.title: Complete semantic-unit/carrier Cartesian-domain correctness

SUCR03.criterion: Verify all 18,639 unit/carrier pairs remain UNRESOLVED and that field-class relations, candidate-family screening, lexical evidence, open-string capacity, and absence from screening were not automatically promoted to unit-context admissibility or losslessness proof.
SUCR03.title: Conservative unit-level admissibility and anti-promotion policy

SUCR04.criterion: Verify exactly 17 requirements remain in scope, zero are claimed uniquely bound, all 17 remain UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_BINDING, and no requirement text was invented, reconstructed from memory, or inferred merely from the count 17.
SUCR04.title: Seventeen-requirement provenance-binding correctness

SUCR05.criterion: Verify the recorded screening-hit count is two, zero explicit cross-unit constraints are accepted, screening is not promoted into semantic proof, the constraint inventory is not claimed complete, and whole-V4 composition enumeration was not performed.
SUCR05.title: Cross-unit coherence screening and non-promotion correctness

SUCR06.criterion: Determine whether FURTHER_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED is a sound bounded outcome given unresolved unit-level admissibility, unresolved requirement provenance, unresolved cross-unit coherence, absence of a positive existing-V2 mapping witness, absence of negative impossibility proof, and absence of whole-V4 exhaustiveness.
SUCR06.title: Soundness of FURTHER_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED

SUCR07.criterion: Verify the Decision-0110 A02 successful output is preserved byte-exactly, consumption is correctly recorded, A02 is permanently retired, and Study V1 can be verified without executing A02 again.
SUCR07.title: Decision-0110 A02 lifecycle and reproducibility

SUCR08.criterion: Verify Study V1 remains AUTHOR_CANDIDATE and does not claim or authorize positive existing-V2 mapping, negative impossibility, whole-V4 exhaustiveness, operational mapping, active Schema-V2 modification, schema-successor authoring, version preselection, Schema V3, curl.json, analyzer implementation/execution, baseline execution, or repair.
SUCR08.title: Governance boundary and technical nonclaims
